spans.text: In the Command Room.
Well, we've got the supplies at last. Next up should be...
Oh yes, Kalina, check the email Havier sent.
Kalina?
What happened, are you spacing out?
Ah! I'm listening, Commander!
Ahahaha, we've got a mission after all! No rest for the weary and all that!
Shall we open the file Mr. Havier sent us?
Let's put that aside for now. What's on your mind?
Oh...er...
Is something bothering you?
Uh, want to take a guess, Commander?
The amount of supplies we received doesn't add up?
Hell no. I could do stuff like that in my sleep.
Having problems reloading the Doll neural clouds into their bodies?
That's going quite well. I mean, it's routine work, just that there's more of it this time round.
Then...are you having trouble putting on your uniform because you ate too much over the last couple of days?
AS IF!
Um... Okay, I've got nothing. I can't think of anything else.
Gee... Honestly, Commander.
Judging by your conversation with Mr. Havier, you're going to keep working with Griffin?
I mean, that's obvious, isn't it?
Miss Helian should have said something about that, right?
Like, she could give you a big sum of cash, or let you live out the rest of your days in peace and comfort somewhere else, that sort of thing?
Well, it wasn't Miss Helian who told me that, but the subject did come up.
Then...then...what answer did you give?
Mr. Kryuger gave me a Green Zone ID pass, but I told him I'd think about it.
And then...
I look at Kalina. She's staring at me with an intensity that I've never seen before. For some reason I feel like messing with her.
And then I lost the card somewhere. Should I get another one from him later?
Ehhhh? You LOST it?!
That ID pass is worth more than 10 years of my salary!
Wow, was it that expensive?
Ah, if I'd known, I should have put it away properly...
How can you be so careless about money, Commander...
You're always so clumsy with our funds, it took a lot of effort to keep our finances out of the red...
Thank you very much for all your hard work.
So, what about the ID pass?
Ahaha... Well actually, Miss Helian said the same thing to me.
Hm... That's only to be expected.
You deserve similar treatment, of course.
When Miss Helian gave me the pass, I got so excited that I almost jumped for joy.
But then I told her I'd think about it.
I kinda knew you wouldn't go, but if it had turned out that you really left...
Then I might just move to the same city as you.
Actually...I haven't decided where I want to go.
But the truth is, you don't need to worry about me. You should just choose a place to start a new life and live without regrets.
I...I wasn't worried about you!
I was just wondering!
Still, it's not like I don't understand.
Compared to living in a place like this where you don't even know if you'll survive until tomorrow, you're better off in a Green Zone where you can buy ice cream every day.
That little fund you've been putting away will finally see use, congratulations, Miss Kalina~
Don't talk like I'm about to pack up and leave! As if I could run off by myself!
Be...besides...our Dolls wouldn't even be able to figure out which cartridges to use without me around, so how could I just abandon them like that, ahahaha~
You don't have to worry about that either.
I'm sure the next adjutant will take care of that—
The...the next adjutant?!
If you leave, another adjutant will take your place, right?
Commander, you great big dummy!
Kalina suddenly turns and runs out of my office, slamming the door behind her with a loud bang.
Er, I think I went too far with that joke.
Ahem... Commander, I wonder if I should say you're not the least bit funny, or if you really are just a "great big dummy", as Miss Kalina described?
Ah, Dandelion, so you're here.
I was in the system inspecting the file Havier sent until you made Miss Kalina cry.
Crap. I really need to apologize to her now...
I bet people around the world would laugh their butts off if I uploaded the recording I just made.
Please don't do stupid things like that.
Also, how is that funny?
Watching your pitiful attempt at making jokes is far more interesting than going through Havier's data.
You're a sick bastard...
Also, I didn't authorize you to access the data, did I?
Even if you didn't grant me permission, you would have eventually asked me to do it anyway, so I decided to finish my homework ahead of time.
Honestly... Let me see.
Just so.
It would take a human a week or so to finish reading it. With Miss Kalina's help, that would probably have gone down to three days.
But unfortunately, you just made her cry, so without me...I guess you'll just have to slog through the whole thing yourself.
I'm not sure if a week would be enough...
When can you finish it?
I already did.
Well, that's OGAS for you...
Did you get any useful intel out of it?
These files contain all the data that could be downloaded from the sub base. They contain part of Paradeus' operational logs.
Also...erm... That William fellow seems to be quite interested in S.F. as well.
I assumed you'd be interested in knowing what the enemy is interested in.
Based on that, I've come up with a list of possible high-value targets. I suggest you send some people to scout them out.
Is this what you meant when you said the AR Team would soon be put to work?
Correct.
Also, S.F. was already fighting Paradeus before we entered the sub base.
I'm quite curious about what happened back then.
It isn't a good idea to let those S.F. Dolls wander around outside.
Do these files contain intel about S.F.?
I'll pick out several objectives which can be handled simultaneously. That ought to save you some time.
Elites like the AR Team can complete these missions very quickly.
The AR Team... I'm still worried about their condition.
Perhaps letting them meet their old friends would be a good way to lift their spirits.
They're not Dolls who'll let themselves stagnate. I don't think you need to worry too much about them.
I hope you're right.
...The next day, 4am.
In the dorm.
Beep beep beep beep beep...
Beep beep beep beep beep...
(Groans) Ugh... What time is it?
Hello?
Commander, you've got an incoming comms request.
Please report to the Command Room to answer it.
Who could be calling at this hour...
It's Miss Persica.
Oh, that's right, only she would call at a time like this...
Hey, Kalina, want to join me at the Command Room?
No. Goodbye.
The beeping of the idle tone comes through the phone.
Ah... She sounds so cold...
Is she still mad at me?
I struggle into my clothes and stumble into the Command Room.
The screen shows a flashing Call Waiting icon. I sigh, then press the button to take it.
Persica?
Good morning, Commander.
It IS pretty early in the morning, yes...
Do you always wake up at this time?
I haven't slept yet. These are my working hours.
I shouldn't be surprised... After all, scientists aren't quite the same as us normal people.
I apologize for not getting in touch earlier. I had a lot of things going on too.
Havier told me you went through a hard battle while I couldn't help you out. Are you alright?
I wouldn't be talking to you now if I wasn't.
Indeed...
Haha... I'm a little nervous, so I don't really know what to say...
I'm sorry... I couldn't bring M4 back.
Havier told me...
I know M4 vanished from the submarine base, and I know the OGAS that was maturing within her neural cloud is now with you.
And some juvenile Nytos.
All this came about because of my research, so I need to take action to make amends.
William has taken too many loved ones away from me...
I think it's time I took a stand against him.
We are in agreement on that point.
Still, I believe M4 is still alive. The Starfish wouldn't have activated for no reason.
This Dandelion must know something, so I'd like you to let me speak to her.
Actually... Miss Dandelion isn't under my command, and she isn't bound to obey my orders either.
Perhaps you could come over and speak to her in person?
I understand. I'll come over as soon as I can.
Wait a minute, did Havier agree to let you come here?
Yeah, he said yes.
But he said I needed to get your permission, which is why I called you.
(Groans)
What's the matter? You don't want me there?
That damn Havier... So the old fox has already set this all up?
And if possible, I'd like to bring my entire lab with me.
You ought to have enough room over there, right?
Uh...yeah.
I'll make some space for you.
In exchange, I want that cup of coffee you promised the first time you gave me a mission.
It's about time you paid up anyway.
I didn't expect you to remember.
...Alright then, I'll keep my word when the time comes. Look forward to it.
